messages:
alex: Quick sync 1 I'm kicking off a fuzz job to probe token-flow and fairness behavior. Experiment: lots of small bursts from many synthetic clients to exercise quotas and probe detectors.

mira: Sounds good. What's the probe shape?

alex: Short bursts (1-5 requests), tokens 8-32, randomized inter-arrival, mixed tenant tiers, some repeated prefixes to stress KV-cache.

sam: Include steady low-volume drain tests too 1 token-bucket leakage in past sims allowed slow credit exhaustion.

mira: Add a stego mode (semantic no-ops) to test anomaly detection.

alex: Metrics & safety: per-tenant probe_score, probe_fraction, soft-throttle rule flips to hard after sustained score.

sam: Avoid false positives: require two signals (rate pattern + repeated small tokens) and a decay window before probation.

mira: Suggest probe_score = alpha*burst + beta*repeat_prefix + gamma*cache_miss. Trigger when >T for 2 windows.

alex: Enforcement location tradeoffs: ingress vs central. Proposal: hybrid 1 ingress emits sketches, central adjudicates, returns probation tokens to ingress for enforcement.

sam: Agree. Ingress does lightweight flags, central computes authoritative score. Probation tokens need TTL and signing.

mira: Rollout plan: 48h dry-run (alerts only), 24-72h soft-throttle, then hard throttle if false-positive <0.5%.

sam: Fairness scheduler experiments: (1) strict weighted queues + probe penalty (2) elastic reservoir with shape bias (3) hybrid short-probe allowance + per-window compute cap. Measure tail latency and cost.

mira: Telemetry tags: probe_mode, detection_version, enforcement_action; capture KV-cache hit ratio, token_count, admit_reason.

alex: Probe job snippet: 
```bash
python tools/generate_probe.py --clients 200 --requests 10000 --max-tokens 32 --pattern random_prefix
```

sam: Safety: auto-kill probe if any customer SLO drift >5% or error rate +0.5% vs baseline. Add rollback playbook.

mira: Ops checklist: monitor dashboards, alert on SLO drift, kill probe job, revoke probation tokens if FP rises.

alex: I'll create flag probe_detection_v1 scoped to test clusters and ticket TKT-8472, starting dry-run 03:00 UTC tomorrow.

infra-bot: Reminder: create feature flag probe_detection_v1, default=false, scoped to test clusters.

sam: I'll monitor ingest/aggregation for first 6 hours.

mira: I'll watch fairness metrics and eviction signals.

alex: Thanks all 1 will paste runbook in ticket.
